name: poster
style: A 1930s Art Deco travel poster come to life: flat bold shapes, strong geometric composition, limited palette of teal, cream, coral and gold, stippled lithograph texture, long stylised shadows, simple elegant animation.
picture_style: Style: a 1930s Art Deco travel poster illustration, flat bold shapes, limited palette of teal, cream, coral and gold, stippled lithograph texture.
voice: A woman with an elegant, warm, inviting voice

case.draw: One upright hard-shell cabin suitcase with four small wheels and a raised telescopic handle, coral red with vertical ribbed lines and gold corner caps, three-quarter view, on a plain flat cream background with one long teal shadow. Completely clean, no stickers.
case.is: the upright coral-red ribbed suitcase with gold corner caps, four small wheels and a raised handle

door.draw: The inside of a stylish hallway by an open front door with morning light streaming in. In the middle stands an upright coral-red ribbed hard-shell suitcase with gold corner caps and a raised handle, now covered all over with round and shield-shaped travel stickers showing tiny pictures of a tower, pyramids, snowy mountains, a palm beach and a pagoda. A hat and a coat hang on a hook beside the door. No lettering.
door.is: the coral-red suitcase covered in picture travel stickers standing in a hallway by an open front door in morning light

clips.sound: A light breeze, small suitcase wheels rolling on stone, a far-off accordion, pigeons taking off.

shots.text: {case} standing alone in the middle of a wide cream-coloured city square at dawn beneath a tall stylised iron lattice tower, long teal shadows stretching across the paving.
{case} rolling by itself along a riverside boulevard past geometric plane trees and a striped cafe awning, a flock of flat white pigeons scattering upward as it passes.
the little coral suitcase rolling up a gangway onto a huge stylised ocean liner with three gold funnels, steam rising in flat curling shapes into a teal sky.

clips.sound: Hot desert wind, then crisp mountain air and a distant cowbell, then warm waves on a beach.

shots.text: {case} rolling across golden sand dunes at sunset in front of three great geometric pyramids, a line of flat camel silhouettes on the horizon.
{case} riding alone in a small open cable car up toward jagged snow-white peaks against a deep teal sky, tiny pine trees far below.
the coral suitcase resting upright on a cream beach under a single leaning palm tree, stylised waves rolling in as flat teal bands, a gold sun sinking into the sea.

clips.sound: A quiet hallway, a clock, a door opening, birds and a taxi horn outside.

shots.text: the tower, the pyramids, the snowy peaks, the palm beach and a pagoda shrinking one after another into small round picture stickers that fly through a cream sky like a flock of birds.
{door}, the last round sticker landing on its side and pressing itself flat.
a close view of the sticker-covered coral suitcase by the open door, its handle rising by itself with a click and its wheels turning toward the bright doorway.
